sections.title: Neighbors *taking care of neighbors*

image.alt: Inside Hibbitts Drug Co.: aisles of health products and diabetic shoes

body: Our mission is to give our community and neighbors friendly, professional and personal healthcare service. We are your locally owned alternative to the big chains.

Owner and pharmacist in charge Amy Young, PharmD, RPh, is local to the New Ellenton area and graduated from the University of South Carolina College of Pharmacy in 2002. She works alongside state and nationally certified pharmacy technicians Stacey Lowe, Glennis Douse and Karen Owens.

items.q: How do I refill a prescription?
items.a: Call (803) 443-0077, or use the free RxLocal app. Please don’t use the website form for refills.

items.q: Can I transfer my prescription to Hibbitts?
items.a: Yes. Call (803) 443-0077 to transfer a prescription.
